settings.text: Discover a new level of relaxation at our partner hotels, each featuring exceptional spa facilities led by Deluxe skincare experts and therapists. These two unique hotels are seamlessly connected to the Only Deluxe brand, offering guests the signature Deluxe experience- where professional care, luxurious treatments, and expert guidance are always at the heart of your stay.

Nestled along the rugged West Coast in the charming fishing village of Paternoster, Abalone Hotel & Villas invites you to trade the bustle of city life for oceanside elegance and tranquil retreats. With five-star flair and a distinctly contemporary coastal style, the hotel combines natural simplicity and refined comfort, think king-size beds, cosy Nespresso-equipped suites, sweeping sea views and a sun-drenched pool just steps from the beach.

Whether you arrive bearing sand from the beach or dust from the road to Paternoster, Abalone offers more than a place to rest; it’s a sanctuary where the Atlantic’s rhythm becomes your lullaby, and where fresh West Coast seafood, soft linens, and salty breezes make every moment feel effortlessly luxurious.

Book Direct and Get 10% Off your stay!

settings.heading: Paternoster Hotel Accommodation
settings.description: Accommodation ranges from stylish hotel rooms and seaview suites to self-catering beach villas and apartments, all designed with comfort, coastal calm and a touch of luxury in mind. Each stay is outfitted with modern comforts such as Nespresso coffee stations, smart TVs, air conditioning and, in many cases, direct access to sunlit patios or serene pools. Whether you’re after a romantic suite by the sea, a relaxed villa on the beach, or a practical apartment base for exploring, Abalone makes sure your stay feels like a home away from home, with all the touches of seaside indulgence.

settings.heading: Dining in Paternoster
settings.description: At Abalone Hotel & Villas, dining is a treat, whether you’re enjoying breakfast, lunch or dinner at their elegant Blues Restaurant or indulging in fresh oysters and Nikkei-style sushi at the cosy Oyster Lounge. Blues Restaurant blends the freshest local produce with inventive Cape-style cuisine — perfect for a relaxed breakfast by the sea, a vibrant lunch, or a romantic dinner as the sun sets. Meanwhile, Oyster Lounge offers a refined, coastal-chic experience: think ocean-fresh oysters and creative sushi and tapas, all washed down with a glass of champagne or a sundowner as you take in the Atlantic views.

settings.heading: Spa’s in Paternoster
settings.description: Whether you’re in need of a soothing massage, a rejuvenating facial, a body wrap or scrub, or simply some time in the sauna or jacuzzi, their four-room spa is ready to restore balance to mind and body. Guests are welcome to book a treatment or indulge in a couples’ package, complete with robes, slippers and full access to heated pools and wellness amenities. The spa at Abalone isn’t about grand indulgence but sincere, thoughtful care, a tranquil corner where the quiet Atlantic rhythm of Paternoster seeps into every moment of your wellness escape.

settings.text:
Welcome to Cloud 9 Boutique Hotel & Spa, a charming blend of Edwardian-era character and modern luxury nestled at the foot of Table Mountain in the heart of Cape Town's vibrant Tamboerskloof district. With its heritage-rich buildings thoughtfully restored and transformed into a cosy 50-room boutique retreat, Cloud 9 offers the perfect base for exploring the city’s lively streets while enjoying refined comforts. Expect stylish rooms, elegant décor, extra touches, and beautifully appointed bathrooms, all wrapped up in a boutique-hotel ambience that feels both timeless and contemporary. Whether you’re here for sightseeing, business or a romantic getaway, Cloud 9 combines location, character and comfort in one memorable stay.

Book Direct and Get 10% Off your stay!

settings.heading: Edwardian Elegance Meets Modern Comfort
settings.description: Discover 50 beautifully appointed rooms where heritage architecture meets contemporary luxury. Each thoughtfully designed space features elegant décor, plush furnishings, and modern amenities that honour the building's Edwardian roots while delivering today's comforts. From cosy standard rooms to spacious suites, every accommodation offers a peaceful retreat with stylish bathrooms, premium linens, and those special touches that make Cloud 9 feel like home. Wake up to Table Mountain views, enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, and let our attentive service ensure your Cape Town stay is nothing short of extraordinary.

settings.heading: Inner City Cape Town Rooftop dining
settings.description: Elevate your dining experience at the Cloud 9 Mountain Club Bistro, Cape Town's premier rooftop restaurant and bar. Voted the number one rooftop bar in Cape Town, this hidden gem sits atop the iconic Cloud 9 Boutique Hotel & Spa, offering spectacular 360-degree views of the city and Table Mountain. Whether you're unwinding after a long day, hosting a corporate event, or celebrating a special occasion, the Mountain Club delivers an unforgettable experience with a plunge pool and open-air ambience. Indulge in mouthwatering breakfast options, tapas, sushi, and showstopper cocktails, all crafted with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. From sunrise to sunset, this rooftop escape blends culinary excellence with breathtaking vistas, making it the ultimate destination for both locals and visitors seeking a taste of elevated luxury in the heart of Cape Town.

settings.heading: Cape Town City Spa
settings.description: Escape to a sanctuary of serenity at the Cloud 9 Deluxe Spa. Our exclusive spa offers a personalised experience from head to toe. Highly qualified therapists and hair stylists use the finest global brands to deliver transformative treatments tailored to your unique needs. From our signature African "Beach" Massage on the innovative gold quartz bed to luxury LED facials, bespoke massages, and award-winning hair rituals, every service is crafted to elevate your well-being. Whether you're seeking a revitalising facial, a soothing massage, or a complete mani-pedi in our Human Touch massage chairs, Cloud 9 Deluxe Spa promises an unforgettable journey of relaxation and renewal.
